blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) in Calabarzon has launched a closed fishing season for Bali Sardinella, locally known as “tamban,” in Tayabas Bay to protect the fish population during its spawning period. “The measure aims to give tamban the opportunity to reproduce and replenish their population, helping maintain an adequate fish supply and ensure the long-term livelihoods of local fisherfolk,” the BFAR office in Region IV-A said in a statement on Wednesday. The closure was formally launched during a ceremony at the Philippine Fisheries Development Authority (PFDA)–Lucena Fish Port Complex in Barangay Dalahican at Lucena […]...
